Title: The Consecration of Aaron and His Sons
DateApprox: c. 1446 BC or c. 1270 BC (date debated by tradition)
KeyPersons: Moses; Aaron; Nadab; Abihu; Eleazar; Ithamar
Events: Moses washes, clothes, and anoints Aaron and his sons, and fire from the Lord consumes the inaugural offering at the tabernacle.
